<p><span class="ma-inline-state" data-state="preliminary">Preliminary campaign</span></p>

<figure class="ma-figure-photo"><img src="/assets/img/photos/cards/mateo.webp" alt="High-Andean wetland with a snow-covered cordillera in the background" width="900" height="600" fetchpriority="high"><div class="ma-photo-note"><span>MeteoAndes archive · 2026 campaign</span><span>Exact site and authorship pending validation</span></div><figcaption>Representative high-mountain image; exact Mateo/Contrayerba identification must be confirmed.</figcaption></figure>

The inventory contains **19 samples**, MAT26_01–19, in consecutive 5 cm intervals from 0 to 95 cm, with a nominal maximum volume of **0.95 L**. AL30 measurements were collected at different elevations, but no altitudinal slope is reported until altitude, time, duration, flow, ATN, temperature, humidity and robust statistics are synchronized.
